financials_interim.notes: Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30.06.2026), same filing as GROUP row (p.2-3,5), COMPANY (parent, standalone) basis. Per Note 5, the 'Company' section covers VLL's own Sri Lanka activities plus its Guyana branch operations; the Company concluded its Guyana EPC contracts during FY2024/25, which explains why Company revenue fell 22.6% YoY to 149,612,607 (2025: 193,235,531) -- a winding-down of that EPC revenue stream, not a core operating deterioration. Despite the revenue fall, Company Other Income and Gain/(Losses) rose 70.7% YoY to 582,266,045 (2025: 341,093,188); the cash flow statement's investing section shows the Company received Dividend Income-Local of 6,977,438 in this period versus a much larger Dividend Income-Overseas of 340,106,968 in the 30.06.2025 comparator period -- the P&L does not separately itemise dividend income within Other Income, so the exact composition of the 582.27mn Other Income figure this quarter is not fully traceable to a single disclosed line, a genuine filing gap. operating_profit derived (as for GROUP) = Gross Profit + Other Income and Gains - Administrative Expenses = 84,212,775 + 582,266,045 - 153,163,339 = 513,315,481; PBT bridge ties exactly: 513,315,481 - 39,228,093 (Finance Cost) + 563,291 (Finance Income) = 474,650,679 = printed PBT (Company has no Investment Share in JV & Associates line, consistent with 'Investments in Subsidiaries'/'Investments in Joint Ventures & Associates' being carried at cost on the standalone balance sheet, not equity-accounted). Company Finance Cost rose 62.5% YoY to 39,228,093 (2025: 24,137,643), tracking the large increase in Company-level current 'Loans and Borrowings' (1,758,760,754 at 30.06.2026 vs 650,155,815 at 31.03.2026). tax_expense is UNUSUALLY a net CREDIT this quarter: the filing prints Income Tax Expense as a positive (un-bracketed) 420,531, i.e. a tax benefit/reversal rather than a charge (2025 comparator: an actual expense of 400,958, bracketed). Stored here as tax_expense=-420531 (negative, signalling a credit) so that the project's PBT-tax_expense=PAT convention holds: 474,650,679-(-420,531)=475,071,210, ~= printed PAT of 475,071,211 (Re.1 rounding). No further explanation for the tax credit is given in this interim filing (gap). Company EPS printed as 0.46 (2025: 0.31); eps_basic/eps_diluted both stored as 0.46 (single undifferentiated line, as for GROUP). No inventory of any note at Company level relative to size (60,070,062, essentially flat YoY); short_term_borrowings = current 'Loans and Borrowings' only (1,758,760,754); long_term_borrowings = non-current 'Loans and Borrowings' only (500,000,000, unchanged from 31.03.2026 -- this is the Rs.500mn Listed Sukuk issued in the 30.06.2025 comparator period per the cash flow statement's financing section). Identity checks: PBT-tax=PAT ties (474,650,679-(-420,531)=475,071,210~=475,071,211); total_liabilities = total_assets-total_equity = 7,736,717,898-4,511,826,543=3,224,891,355, cross-checked against Non-Current (648,483,681) + Current (2,576,407,674) Liabilities = 3,224,891,355 -- ties exactly.

Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30.06.2026, VLL's fiscal year ends 31 March), p.2 balance sheet, p.3 income statement, p.5 cash flow. GROUP basis. Figures in the filing are in whole Rs (not Rs'000), hence unit_scale='1'. operating_profit is NOT a printed subtotal in this filing (unlike RHL's 'Profit/(Loss) from Operations' or KPHL's 'Profit from operating activities') -- it is DERIVED here as Gross Profit + Other Income and Gain/(Losses) - Administrative Expenses = 811,356,837 + 330,356,838 - 243,984,797 = 897,728,878 (i.e. PBT before Finance Cost/Income and Investment Share in JV & Associates). PBT bridge verified exactly: 897,728,878 (derived operating profit) - 147,148,882 (Finance Cost) + 1,470,761 (Finance Income) + 87,741,840 (Investment Share in Joint Ventures & Associate) = 839,792,597 = printed PBT, ties. ONE-OFF FLAG: Other Income and Gain/(Losses) surged 3353% YoY to 330,356,838 (2025: 9,567,373) -- the cash flow statement's 'Adjustments for' section reveals a 'Gain on Bargain Purchase' of 308,331,328 (no prior-year comparative shown, i.e. this item did not exist in Q1 FY2025/26), which is almost certainly the dominant driver of this Other Income surge and, by extension, of most of the Group's 62% YoY PBT growth (PBT rose 321,509,760 YoY; the bargain-purchase gain alone is 308,331,328, i.e. ~96% of the total PBT increase). This gain relates to Note 8's acquisition of PPE for DPV Solar Energy (Pvt) Ltd (10MW Ground Mounted Solar Power plant, Hambantota District, Rs.843mn of the PPE increase this quarter) -- a bargain purchase arises when a business combination's identifiable net assets fair value exceeds consideration paid. Without this one-off, underlying Group PBT growth would have been far more modest / potentially negative once the near-doubling of Finance Cost is also considered. Finance Cost rose 93% YoY to 147,148,882 (2025: 76,153,760), consistent with the Group's much larger interest-bearing debt base (Loans and Borrowings, current+non-current, rose from 3,765,126,022+1,138,376,214=4,903,502,236 at 31.03.2026 to 4,627,482,243+2,354,136,908=6,981,619,151 at 30.06.2026) taken on to fund Note 9's Rs.2.275bn investment in new projects (of which Rs.2.205bn in Storex (Pvt) Ltd for a 120MW/480MWh Battery Energy Storage System) and the DPV Solar acquisition. Investment Share in the Joint Ventures & Associate rose 269% YoY to 87,741,840 (2025: 23,785,578); per Note 2's per-associate breakdown, Solar Universe (Pvt) Ltd's own share of comprehensive income rose from 2,543,082 to 58,798,434 (+2,212%), the single largest contributor to this JV/associate income growth. FX: Group Other Comprehensive Income includes an Exchange Difference on Translation of Foreign Operations gain of 341,447,164 (2025: 61,557,797 gain, +454%), reflecting LKR movement against the currency of VLL's overseas hydro operations (Hydro-Overseas segment, revenue 666,736k) -- this is an OCI item, not part of PBT/PAT. Separately, the cash flow statement's 'Net Gain / Loss on Translation of Foreign Currency' operating add-back rose to 113,827,418 (2025: 9,734,259), indicating a materially larger non-cash FX translation loss was absorbed within this quarter's P&L than a year earlier (this add-back convention reverses a P&L loss out of the operating cash flow reconciliation) -- the specific P&L line it sits within is not separately disclosed, a filing-level gap. By segment (Note 7, in Rs'000): revenue fell in Power Generation Hydro-Local (171,832 vs 193,236 PY, -11.1%), Hydro-Overseas (666,736 vs 680,964, -2.1%) and Dendro & Plantation (31,052 vs 116,100, -73.3%), while Engineering Consultancy & Project Management grew (78,959 vs 30,275, +160.8%) and Solar surged (178,852 vs 30,818, +480.3%, reflecting the new DPV Solar capacity). No rainfall/hydrology commentary is given anywhere in this filing to explain the Hydro-Local/Overseas revenue declines (Note 6 only quantifies grid-curtailment energy of Rs.91.55mn cumulative March 2025-June 2026, a distinct concept from rainfall) -- a genuine disclosure gap, flagged rather than inferred. tax_expense = Income Tax Expense (284,180,551); Note 10 states Group Income Tax expenses include Dividend Withholding Tax of Rs.106.25mn. minority_interest = Non-Controlling Interest's share of Profit for the Period (15,961,907), per the 'Profit attributable to' split (not a balance-sheet NCI equity figure). total_liabilities = Total Assets - Total Equity = 20,771,561,017 - 10,559,683,244 = 10,211,877,773, cross-checked against Note 7's segment table Total Liabilities column sum of 10,211,878 ('000) -- ties. short_term_borrowings = current 'Loans and Borrowings' only (2,354,136,908); long_term_borrowings = non-current 'Loans and Borrowings' only (4,627,482,243); Lease Liability (both current 10,757,667 and non-current 60,590,725) is excluded as a distinct lease obligation, not conventional debt, consistent with the RHL precedent in this DB. capex = Acquisition of Property, Plant and Equipment (859,604,439) only (Investment in Biological Assets was nil this period, vs 4,691,608 PY); the much larger 'Net Investment in New Projects' (2,274,902,095, Note 9's BESS/Storex investment) is a separate investing line, not treated as capex. shares_in_issue = Voting 953,670,358 + Non-Voting 82,113,575 = 1,035,783,933 (dual-class, matches Weighted Average No of Shares of 1,034,916,568 used for EPS closely). eps_basic/eps_diluted both stored as 0.52 -- the filing prints a single undifferentiated 'Earnings Per Share' line, no separate basic/diluted disclosure. Identity checks: PBT-tax=PAT ties (839,792,597-284,180,551=555,612,046); total_assets=total_liab+total_equity ties (20,771,561,017=10,211,877,773+10,559,683,244).
